title: Silt Residue Pass after Standing Water (Water Damage Mitigation)
content:
Water Damage Mitigation application standard. Silt left by standing water takes a heavier pass in the final cleaning: the residue pass factor on the final HEPA vacuuming line is 1.4 when the job's opened date is two or more days after its loss date, 1.2 when it is exactly one day after the loss date, and when the job was opened on its loss date no residue pass factor applies. The pass factor multiplies the vacuumed square feet.

The loss date and the opened date are those on the job record; the gap is counted in calendar days.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical loss on the 20th)
| Opened on | Days after the loss | Residue pass factor |
|---|---|---|
| the 20th | 0 | none |
| the 21st | 1 | 1.2 |
| the 22nd | 2 | 1.4 |
| the 27th | 7 | 1.4 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)
A vacuumed area of 500 square feet counts as 600 square feet under a residue pass factor of 1.2 and as 700 square feet under 1.4.
